ThingDef.label: Asuran nanite residue
ThingDef.description: A stabilized sample of microscopic synthetic material recovered from a destroyed hostile human-form Asuran. The residue is a WNG salvage abstraction of the nanite substrate that composes Pegasus human-form Replicators. It can be analyzed at a research bench to establish the colony's first practical understanding of Asuran programmable-nanite fabrication.

li.completedLetter: Analysis of the recovered Asuran nanite residue has revealed enough of its programmable synthetic substrate to begin {RESEARCH}.
li.activateDescString: Analyze this recovered Asuran nanite residue at a research bench to unlock Asuran nanite fabrication research.
li.guiLabelString: Choose a colonist to analyze the Asuran nanite residue.
li.inspectString: Can be analyzed at a research bench to unlock Asuran nanite fabrication.
